stories.source_title: Interview: Manana Knows That Things Aren’t Always What They Seem
stories.source_excerpt: Across 10 songs, Manana's buttery vocals float languidly over delicate R&B instrumentation as both an invocation and honest approximation. The post Interview: Manana Knows That Things Aren’t Always What They Seem appeared first on The NATIVE .
stories.headline: Inside Manana's Ten-Song Journey of R&B and Realities
stories.dek: The acclaimed artist shares a transparent body of work defined by smooth vocals and introspective songwriting.
stories.body:
Music lovers are diving into a rich sonic experience as Manana delivers a ten-track project that leans heavily into delicate R&B instrumentation. As highlighted in a recent profile by The NATIVE, the singer utilizes his signature buttery vocal delivery to guide listeners through an honest approximation of life's complexities.

Throughout the ten songs, the music operates as both a personal invocation and a direct exploration of perspective. The instrumentation remains understated, allowing the emotional weight of the lyricism to take center stage and connect deeply with audiences.

This latest release further solidifies the artist's reputation for crafting thoughtful, immersive soundscapes. By examining themes of perception and reality, the project encourages fans to look closer at the world around them.

As the tracks continue to resonate across streaming platforms, this cohesive body of work stands as a testament to contemporary R&B craftsmanship. It proves that understated production, paired with genuine vocal vulnerability, remains a powerful vehicle for storytelling.

stories.headline: GRAMMY Winner Matt B Traces Roots Back to West Africa
stories.dek: An ordinary ancestry test sparked a transformative creative journey that ultimately shaped a major new musical project.
stories.body:
A simple AncestryDNA test taken six years ago set GRAMMY Award-winning artist Matt B on an unexpected path of self-discovery, leading directly to the vibrant cultures of Ghana and Nigeria. According to reports from NotJustOk, this personal reconnection with his ancestral homeland formed the foundation for a profound artistic evolution.

The profound physical and cultural journey across West Africa culminated in the creation of 'ALKEBULAN III: The Water Remembers.' The ambitious project dives deeply into themes of heritage, personal identity, and the enduring strength of history against attempts at erasure.

By turning personal lineage into a rich creative endeavor, Matt B bridges continents through sound. The work captures the essence of what it means to reclaim a narrative that spans generations and geography.

Fans and critics alike are engaging with the project not just as a collection of music, but as a cultural document. It highlights the enduring power of roots and the ways in which contemporary artists continue to honor their history.

stories.headline: The Tix Index 2026 Maps Out Nigeria's Experience Economy
stories.dek: A newly released report compiles three years of proprietary data to chart how live events and entertainment are changing across Nigeria.
stories.body:
Industry stakeholders and event creators have a new resource to understand the shifting landscape of entertainment with the official launch of The Tix Index 2026. Reported by The NATIVE, the newly published index relies on a robust foundation of proprietary data gathered consistently between 2023 and 2025.

By leveraging three years of insights, the platform successfully maps out the steady evolution of Nigeria's dynamic experience economy. The data offers a clearer picture of how audiences engage with live entertainment, gatherings, and commercial events over time.

As the entertainment sector continues to expand rapidly, comprehensive metrics like those provided in the index have become vital for organizers and businesses. Understanding past trends helps chart a sustainable path forward for creators within the space.

The release underscores the growing maturity of the local entertainment ecosystem, where data-driven insights now match the immense creativity of the region. Industry participants are expected to utilize these findings to shape upcoming experiences.

The post Salif Keita cancels South Africa concerts due to reports of xenophobic attacks appeared first on NotjustOk .
stories.headline: Salif Keita Pulls Out of South Africa Shows Over Safety Concerns
stories.dek: The celebrated Malian music icon has called off scheduled performances in response to ongoing reports of xenophobic violence.
stories.body:
Malian music legend and global icon Salif Keita has made the difficult decision to cancel his upcoming concert in South Africa. According to updates shared by NotJustOk, the cancellation comes directly in response to troubling reports of ongoing xenophobic attacks within the country.

As a revered voice on the continent and a champion of unity, Keita's choice to step back highlights the severe impact that social unrest has on cultural exchange and live entertainment. The artist prioritized safety and solidarity in light of the hostile environment.

Concertgoers and supporters of the legendary musician now face the disappointment of postponed live performances, yet the decision has drawn widespread attention to the pressing issue of regional tolerance. Music has long served as a bridge across African nations, making incidents of hostility particularly stark.

For now, fans and promoters await further developments as the continent reflects on the broader implications of these events. Keita's stance places a sharp focus on the safety of artists and audiences alike within the global touring circuit.

stories.source_title: BoyPee Is Feeling Good on “For You”
stories.source_excerpt: Produced by Izzybeatzz and co-produced by ELVEES BEATS, "For You" is an easygoing love song with enough bounce to get people moving. The post BoyPee Is Feeling Good on “For You” appeared first on The NATIVE .
stories.headline: BoyPee Delivers Infectious Energy on New Single 'For You'
stories.dek: The artist returns with an easygoing love record designed to ignite dancefloors.
stories.body:
The vibrant African music landscape continues to expand its sonic footprint, and BoyPee is right at the forefront with his latest release. According to recent reports from The NATIVE Music, the rising talent has dropped a brand-new track titled "For You," showcasing his ability to blend heartfelt sentiment with irresistible rhythms. Fans of contemporary sounds will find plenty to love in this upbeat offering.

At the core of the song's sonic identity is its stellar production team. The track was brought to life by producer Izzybeatzz, with additional co-production handling by ELVEES BEATS. Together, they have crafted a rich instrumental backdrop that elevates BoyPee's smooth vocal delivery.

Described as an easygoing love song, "For You" avoids heavy-handed tropes in favor of an inviting, breezy atmosphere. Yet, it maintains a distinct rhythmic pulse that sets it apart from standard ballads. The production boasts enough bounce to effortlessly transition from casual listening sessions to packed club floors.

As the single makes its way across digital streaming platforms, it reinforces BoyPee's growing reputation as a versatile voice in the scene. With strong production credentials and a universally appealing theme, "For You" stands out as a noteworthy addition to the contemporary African music canon.

stories.headline: Swayvee Explores Late-Night Romance on 'Get Lucky'
stories.dek: The artist delivers a carefree and flirtatious anthem focused on magnetic physical chemistry and living strictly in the moment.
stories.body:
Swayvee is capturing attention with a vibrant new release titled 'Get Lucky'. According to recent lyric insights, the track dives straight into the electrifying atmosphere of late-night attraction, secrecy, and impulsive lifestyle choices. It leans heavily on themes of strong romantic connection.

The single highlights a compelling subject who has managed to completely capture the artist's focus. Throughout the track, Swayvee maintains a thoroughly rebellious attitude when it comes to outside opinions, choosing instead to prioritize the immediate vibe and mutual fascination.

At the core of the production is a memorable and repeated hook that reinforces the ultimate ambition of the song: spending the entire night fully immersed in the experience. The carefree lyricism paints a vivid picture of two people letting go of caution.

Listeners drawn to bold romantic themes and high-energy nocturnal anthems will find plenty to appreciate in this latest drop. Swayvee continues to showcase a distinct approach to storytelling through music that resonates deeply with contemporary fans.
